description: This file contains a static utility class 'RuntimeTypeNameFormatter' that provides methods for formatting .NET Type objects into string representations that can be parsed back by Type.GetType(). It includes methods for handling type aliases, generic types, arrays, pointers, and other type constructs, with caching for performance.

classes.name: RuntimeTypeNameFormatter
classes.description: A static class providing methods to format Type objects into parseable string representations.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a Type that can be parsed by Type.GetType().

methods.name: FormatInternalNoCache
methods.description: Formats a Type into a string without using cache, with optional alias allowance.
